# שקוף (Shakuf)

> Free, open-source accessibility widget for Hebrew websites. It adds one button through which each visitor adjusts the display: text size, contrast, spacing, motion, and more. No server, no account, no data collection. It adjusts display only; it does not make a site conform to SI 5568 (Israeli Standard 5568, WCAG 2.1 AA) and is not a substitute for making the site accessible.

Built and maintained by Yuval Rahamim (https://yuvalrahamim.com/). Apache-2.0. Published on npm as @shakuf-widget/widget.

## Pages (Hebrew unless noted)

- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/ : what it is, what it changes, what Israeli law requires that a widget cannot provide
- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/en/ : English overview
- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/setup/ : installation (one script tag), per-platform instructions, configuration attributes, self-hosting, CSP
- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/disclaimer/ : what the tool does and does not do, and why it says so
- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/terms/ : terms of use
- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/accessibility/ : this site's own accessibility statement
- https://shakuf.yuvalrahamim.com/changelog/ : release notes
